blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Association of Southeast Asian Nation (Asean) member-states have adopted a declaration pushing for the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to help micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) be part of an inclusive economic growth. A copy of the declaration signed on Sunday showed that the 11 member-states agreed to adopt the Asean Leaders’ Declaration on AI-Powered MSME Growth, which seeks to transform AI from an “abstract or out-of-reach technology into a practical and affordable instrument for inclusive economic growth.” Part of the declaration is a 12-point commitment of each member-state, including how to help MSMEs understand how AI […]...
